actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Milei continues to dominate headlines with his aggressive economic reforms, including the elimination of the Interior Ministry and restructuring of the Central Bank. His government faces high disapproval ratings but remains focused on pushing through legislative changes ahead of the 2027 elections. Milei's international engagements, such as congratulating Peru's president-elect Keiko Fujimori, also keep him in the spotlight.

Magyar's clashes with former President János Áder and his government's handling of public media and EU funds are key drivers of current coverage.
